Black Mirror.overview: Twisted tales run wild in this mind-bending anthology series that reveals humanity's worst traits, greatest innovations and more.

Secret Level.overview: Adult animated series of original short stories which are set within the worlds of beloved video games. Each episode serves as a gateway to a new adventure, unlocking exciting worlds from beloved gaming classics and highly anticipated new titles.
episodeTitles: New World: The Once and Future King
Warhammer 40,000: And They Shall Know No Fear
The Outer Worlds: The Company We Keep
Honor of Kings: The Way of All Things

Gen V.overview: At America's only college for superheroes, gifted students put their moral boundaries to the test, competing for the university's top ranking, and a chance to join The Seven, Vought International's elite superhero team. When the school's dark secrets come to light, they must decide what kind of heroes they want to become.
episodeTitles: The Kids Are Not All Right

Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosit.overview: Bizarre nightmares unfold in eight tales of terror in this visually stunning, spine-tingling horror collection curated by Guillermo del Toro.

Love, Death & Robots.overview: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.
episodeTitles: The Very Pulse of the Machine
Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
